text:
This composition looks like a maraging-type steel: low carbon, 12% Ni, 4.7% Cr, 3.2% Mo, with Al and Ti additions that form NiAl and Ni3Ti precipitates. It resembles a Ni-Al-Ti precipitation-hardened steel, similar to PH 13-8Mo (12.5% Ni, 2.2% Mo, 1.1% Al) or Custom 465 (11% Ni, 11% Cr). Aged strengths for these grades run about 1400–1700 MPa. The Al and Ti content here is moderate at 0.47% Al and 0.19% Ti, so I estimate about 1500 MPa. This is a judgment from alloy type, not a calculation.
